user_authority: Patch the three Live warnings and restore future entry readiness without causing missed entries.

incident.detail: owned pending order on mismatched component

broker_terminal_trace.timing: Safety stop was logged immediately before the stop-loss deal completed.

incident.missed_window_boundary: The later server-17:00 Cross component remained NOT_EVALUATED_SINCE_START. No late or hindsight order may be created after its two-minute deadline.

root_cause.cause: OrdersTotal includes active market orders that have not yet completed. The audit recognized only the Passive BUY_LIMIT/SELL_LIMIT shape and classified every other owned Magic as an impossible pending order, including the broker-generated market order executing a saved position stop loss.

fixed_change.classification: Allow one currently selected order to bypass the impossible-owned-order stop only when every stop-loss-transit predicate passes.
required_predicates: Magic and symbol map exactly to one portfolio component.
Order type is ORDER_TYPE_BUY or ORDER_TYPE_SELL.
The mapped local component has a nonzero active position_identifier, direction and volume.
The market order direction is opposite the saved position direction.
ORDER_VOLUME_INITIAL equals the saved position volume within half a symbol volume step.
ORDER_POSITION_ID may be zero before execution; if nonzero it must equal the saved position identifier.
unchanged_fail_closed_cases: client, mobile, web, expert or take-profit reason
limit, stop, stop-limit or close-by type

fixed_validation.compile: MetaEditor build 6140 must report 0 errors and 0 warnings.
fixed_validation.runtime_path: One serial fresh-100-USD 100-percent-real-tick path from 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-21.
requirements: Candidate exactly matches all frozen control economic and count fields.
Candidate stops normally at 100 percent real ticks.
Safety, persistence, broker, foreign, protection and ownership faults are zero.
Source, configuration, binary and required-symbol contract fingerprints remain fixed across the path.
fixed_validation.test_limit: Exactly one successful candidate economic path; implementation-only failures before outcome may be corrected and disclosed.

promotion_and_recovery_gate.live_package: Promote only the exact changed ownership module plus a new release identity into one frozen active package; keep execution/economic identity, Portfolio, Magic, settings and state schema/path unchanged.
promotion_and_recovery_gate.flat_boundary: Before package replacement, the current Live owner must show zero local positions, Passive order, margin, planned risk, retry, shadow and ARC ownership, then stop normally.
promotion_and_recovery_gate.latched_fault_recovery: Back up both stopped state snapshots. Clear only the persisted safety_stopped field in both otherwise byte-preserved flat snapshots; broker_mismatch is runtime-only and resets before exact broker reconciliation. Preserve all balances, counters, decisions, events and component state.
promotion_and_recovery_gate.restart: Use the committed operator for exact entries-disabled 0/0 recovery and then exact Live 1/1 handshake. If either fails, remain stopped or entries-disabled according to the existing fail-closed contract.
promotion_and_recovery_gate.missed_entry_policy: Do not place a late replacement for the already-expired Cross window. Future windows resume only after the 1/1 handshake.
